title: AI labs want in-house auditors — but maybe they should shut the front door first | TechCrunch
summary: Internet security experts say the labs need to focus on network security basics like logs and permissions, applying the same rigorous defenses they do for human users. Neither company responded to TechCrunch’s questions about how they track and control AI agents.
